For Jean-Pierre Bourhis, every stroke carries a dream forward. 

A Senegalese Olympian, an engineer in Paris, and a selected Role Model for the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, Jean-Pierre wants young canoeists in Senegal to have the tools and support they need to grow.

With Galaxy technology in his hands, he helps athletes understand the water, build confidence, and move closer to their goals.

Discover his journey.
